pillars.name: Autonomous AI Agents & Cognitive Systems
core_themes: Multi-agent orchestration and failure recovery
Deterministic guardrails vs probabilistic LLM reasoning
Tool use benchmarks, evaluation, and latency optimization
Local LLM deployment and edge intelligence

pillars.name: Embedded Systems & Low-Level Firmware
core_themes: Bare-metal C/C++ and FreeRTOS concurrency on STM32 / ESP32
Hardware bus protocol debugging (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN)
Memory profiling, DMA transfers, and interrupt latency
Ultra-low-power sleep optimization

pillars.name: Robotics & Mechatronics
core_themes: Kinematics and actuator control (Field Oriented Control, Stepper)
Sensor fusion (Extended Kalman Filters, IMU, LiDAR)
Sim-to-real transfer and physics engine validation
ROS2 node architecture and deterministic communication

pillars.name: 3D Engineering & Rapid Hardware Prototyping
core_themes: Parametric CAD modeling for functional enclosures
DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and tolerance analysis
FDM/SLA 3D printing parameter tuning for structural load
Thermal management and mechanical stress distribution
required_artifacts: Stress analysis FEA or physical break-test photo

pillars.name: Software Engineering & Systems Infrastructure
core_themes: Distributed backend systems and microservices
Developer CLI tooling and performance profiling
Reliability engineering and root-cause post-mortems
Data streaming and state machine implementations
